meta.source: GO Train App Product Design Brief v1 (4 Nov 2026), built on the Apple-inspired DESIGN.md from VoltAgent/awesome-design-md, re-tinted to indigo and slate

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind lists, the route form and the Alerts tab. A cool parchment (Apple uses a warm #F5F5F7; ours leans blue).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid ground for departure rows, cards, sheets and the tab bar. Critical times always sit on this, never on a translucent layer.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fills inside a surface: search field, inactive chips, segmented control track, Scheduled badge, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px separators between rows and around cards on canvas. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outlines that identify a control (off switch track, empty day chip, secondary button). At least 3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: route names, departure times, headings, body. On canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels and metadata: Departs, Scheduled arrival, line name, Platform, freshness text. On canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, the struck-through scheduled time of a cancelled train, disabled labels. On canvas, surface and surface-raised (4.5:1 minimum).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: primary pill buttons, links, selected chips, active tab, bell when an alert is on. Replaces Apple's Action Blue.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a primary button, paired with a 0.97 scale.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark text in the dark theme because the accent lightens there.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, watched-trip strip, selected segment. Text on it is accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable control (keyboard and Switch Control). 6:1 or better on canvas and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ontime-ink
tokens.usage: On time label and checkmark icon, on ontime-fill or surface. Only with fresh live evidence.

tokens.name: ontime-fill
tokens.usage: On time badge background.

tokens.name: delay-ink
tokens.usage: Delayed N min label, clock icon and expected time emphasis, on delay-fill or surface.

tokens.name: delay-fill
tokens.usage: Delayed badge background; also the compact line-disruption banner.

tokens.name: cancel-ink
tokens.usage: Cancelled / Stop skipped label and octagon icon, on cancel-fill or surface. Green vs red here differ mostly by hue, so always pair with the word and icon.

tokens.name: cancel-fill
tokens.usage: Cancelled badge background; Could not save alert state.

tokens.name: scheduled-ink
tokens.usage: Scheduled, Last reported and Offline badges: neutral on purpose, so missing live data never looks green.

tokens.name: scheduled-fill
tokens.usage: Scheduled, Last reported and Offline badge background.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind native sheets (trip details, alert setup, station search).

families.system: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: time-lead
styles.usage: Next usable departure only. Tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; SwiftUI .monospacedDigit()).

styles.name: time-row
styles.usage: Later departures in the list. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: time-arrival
styles.usage: Destination arrival beside a departure. Tabular numerals; always labelled Scheduled or Est.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Top of the Alerts and Settings tabs. Weight 600, never 700 (Apple rule kept).

styles.name: route
styles.usage: Route header and trip-detail title. Wraps to two lines before truncating.

styles.name: nav-title
styles.usage: Small inline title on Schedule; sheet titles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles in Alerts, station names in search, notification titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Updates start 1 hour before the scheduled departure.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Line name, sheet supporting text, empty-state sentence.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Freshness, Departs / Scheduled arrival labels, Platform. Smallest size allowed at default Dynamic Type.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badge labels, chips, Express tag.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Native tab bar labels only (system size; scales with Dynamic Type via the tab bar).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges; label-to-value gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; between time and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked rows of metadata inside a departure row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Departure row padding; card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side margin on every screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between header block and list; sheet top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap in Alerts and Settings; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top air above an empty-state illustration-free message.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks, small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Search field, banner, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped departure lists (Apple's store card radius, kept).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of custom sheet previews; native sheets use system radius.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary/secondary buttons, chips, status badges, day chips: the pill is the action signal.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for bell, swap, star, gear, chips and every control.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: SF Symbol size for bell, swap, star, gear in rows and headers.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: SF Symbol size inside status badges.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a standard departure row at default text size.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas in light mode. Dark mode relies on the surface step instead.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The one real shadow: sheets and the notification preview floating over content.
